about: Tier 0 asset budgets, read from files only (tools/tier0/budgets.mjs). Per-asset caps, the summed resident-texture ledger and the summed shipped-size ledger. Line figures are the plan's estimates; the totals are the caps. Paths are repo-relative prefixes (no globs).

hero.about: Brea as worn: the body plus one outfit or armour rung, LOD 0.

npc.about: Near-tier person (LOD 0 meshes plus any unsuffixed mesh such as a shadow caster). Atlas carriers and the clip pack are not bodies.

instruments.about: Each Instrument model needs a size class; the caps are per class.

textures.about: Largest edge of any shipped texture. Uncompressed textures stay at 1024 until KTX2 (M0.10) is in the build; KTX2 textures may be 2048.

resident.about: Resident texture memory if every shipped texture is resident at once (no streaming exists yet), identical images counted once. RGBA8 with mips for PNG/JPEG/WebP, 8 bpp with mips for KTX2. Textures built at runtime (sky, LUTs, UI canvases) are not on disk and are not counted.

lines.label: people: heads, bodies and outfit atlases

shipped.about: Bytes that ship: public/ (tracked + untracked-not-ignored) plus the built JS and CSS. The first load is the boot set (every public/ file not in the deferred set) plus the built code, against firstLoadCapMb; the total is every file, against the milestone's totalCapMb. Megabytes here are decimal (10^6 bytes), as tools/perf/boot-transfer.mjs measures them. The deferred set is what the game fetches only after she is under control, read from the game's own modules (deferred: module, its array export of paths relative to `under`), so the ledger and the game share one list. tools/perf/boot-transfer.mjs measures what the built game really fetches before control.

deferred.about: the first hour's audio bank (Milestone 2): fetched and decoded after New Game or Continue gives control (src/audio/bank.js loadLate)

the Holds people's own GLBs: the cast is spawned within SPAWN_R (180 m) of Ninewalls' centre (src/world/npc/people/holds.js HOLDS_CAST, streamed by her distance; Oro by the quest's 'oro' stage), except the archetypes the W1 group stages at boot (src/world/npc/people/ids.js ARCHETYPE_IDS: pit-farmer, tiller-follower, cochineal-picker, and with them atlas-holds, stay in the first load)
the Malpais' ground layers (Milestone 3 wave 2): fetched on the region's approach (src/world/sites/malpais-region.js; regions.js malpais at 60 m on foot, 150 m in the air), never at boot (MP11)
